checks: browser does not pretend to retain native disk permission
native IPC: autosave registers persistent identity, same-name paths are distinct, repeated open reuses tab and preserves edits
reload restores saved tab plus independent dirty recovery copy, active order, and explicit original-disk reopen without draft writeback
workspace reopen persists selection, missing-file failure preserves body, per-record removal and cancelled asynchronous open release unused handle
clear history only removes registry entries, leaves disk bodies and open tabs, Escape restores menu focus
scope: Production Chromium pointer/keyboard and IndexedDB with deterministic desktop IPC. Native registry/path IO is covered separately by Rust tests; no real OS dialog or native restart claim.
